name: Creative test reader
summary: Reads how live ad creative tests are performing on the ad platform, keeps a snapshot, and queues a pause for any losing ad for a person to approve. Crons read and queue; nothing launches, spends or pauses without approval.

crons.name: monitor
crons.summary: Read spend, impressions, clicks and CTR for each ad in the account and keep the snapshot.

crons.name: review
crons.summary: Queue a pause for each active ad that has spent past the threshold with a CTR under the floor.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only: ad insights and the list of active ads. Pausing an ad changes what a customer's ad does, so Ad.post.self is a live operation that is only ever queued for approval.

meta-ads.covers: read ad insights and active ads; queue an ad pause for approval

gaps: TikTok Ads: the kit has no ops file for tiktok-ads, so no operations are mapped. Its test setup, review and reporting steps stay manual until an ops file exists.
Test brief, asset gathering, variant production, client updates and record keeping have no mapped operations. The agent skill covers them, or the owner does them by hand.

Set-up test, launch test and scale winner (creating campaigns, ad sets and ads, turning them on, changing budgets) are not built. They need a live approval flow for each write before they can be added.
Pick winner only pauses losing ads. It does not promote a winner or move budget to it.
Creating new ad creatives (AdAccount.post.adcreatives) is not built. Iteration needs a person to write the next round until a draft path is designed.
Meta's ops file tags AdSet.get.insights as a write even though it is a read. This workflow does not use it. The kit owner should correct the tag.

Active-ad reads cover the first page only. Following paging.next needs core: AdAccount.get.ads in core/sdk/platforms/meta-ads/ops.json maps no limit or after parameter, and the SDK refuses unmapped params. Until then a losing ad past that page is not paused (the safe direction).
The review cron uses the snapshot from the last monitor run, which can be up to six hours old.
Thresholds (minimum spend, CTR floor, pause cap) are starting values. The owner sets them per client before the review cron is relied on.
Every Meta step is partial in the platform docs and the docs are developer docs, not product help. Each step needs a check in Ads Manager before it is relied on.
The workflow is docs-only until a sandbox or test ad account proves the read and pause operations.
